introduce:
Sit on a chair with your arms bent at 90 degree angles. 

Put your palms up, clench your fists and keep your thumbs pointed outward. Sit up straight, and squeeze your arms towards your upper body.  

Rotate your forearms outward horizontally, then bring them back. Repeat the exercise.
name: SHOULDER OUTWARD ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when rotating your forearms outward, and inhale when bringing them back.
Please squeeze your shoulder blades when rotating outward.
Please always keep your shoulders flat.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor. 

Then lift your arms overhead and stretch your chest out. When you exhale, lower your arms until they're parallel to the floor. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: BACK ARCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you lift your arms and exhale when you lower.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Cross your fingers and squeeze your palms together.\n\nTake your wrist circles one way. Reversion your direction and repeat.
name: CHAIR WRIST STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your palms together.
This exercise promotes wrist flexibility and helps ease wrist pain.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Reach your left palm forward. Take your right hand over these fingers.\n\nGently pull the fingers of your left hand toward your body. Hold for a while and back to the starting position and repeat.
name: CHAIR FOREARM STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when you pull and inhale when you release fingers.
This exercise stretches your forearm.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Reach your right palm forward. Take your left hand over these fingers.\n\nGently pull the fingers of your right hand toward your body. Hold for a while and back to the starting position and repeat.
name: CHAIR FOREARM STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when you pull and inhale when you release fingers.
This exercise stretches your forearm.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Place your left arm across your body, parallel to the ground.\n\nUse your right arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR SHOULDER STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder and stretch in the back of your left shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Place your right arm across your body, parallel to the ground.\n\nUse your left arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR SHOULDER STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder and stretch in the back of your right shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor.

Put your left hand on your back and reach down as far as you can. Use your right hand to grab your left elbow.

Bend your upper body to the right. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR TRICEPS SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Take deeper stretches with every breath.
You can feel your triceps, obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor.

Put your right hand on your back and reach down as far as you can. Use your left hand to grab your right elbow.

Bend your upper body to the left. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR TRICEPS SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Take deeper stretches with every breath.
You can feel your triceps, obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart. Put your hands beside your ears.\n\nRotate your body gently and slowly. This stretches your back and hips.
name: CHAIR TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes and knees should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Please relax your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Put your hands behind your head and open your elbows to the sides.\n\nHinge at your hips and lean your upper body forward. Come back and repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Put your knees hip-width apart and keep them still.
Bring your upper body as close to your thighs as possible.
Inhale as you lean forward, and exhale as you come back.
You can feel the stretch in your glutes and back.
